newsitem.title: USA: Tellabs OK with '97 EPS $1.25 estimate.
newsitem.headline: Tellabs OK with '97 EPS $1.25 estimate.

text.p: Tellabs Inc president Peter Guglielmi said the company is comfortable with Wall Street consensus estimates of $1.25 a share for 1997, and he expects it could hit $2.0 billion in revenue prior to its target date in the year 2000.

Speaking after a presentation to a Hambrecht & Quist Technology conference, here, Guglielmi declined to comment on recent market rumors that his company was interested in an acquisition of Fore Systems. But he added that Tellabs would continue to evaluate acquisition possibilities.
"We're going to look at strategic opportunities in addition to the products we have today," he said.
Guglielmi said the company will also look for acquisitions overseas, including the Asia-Pacific region and Brazil.
"I think we've got a good chance at making that $2 billion (revenue target) by 1999," he told reporters.
Guglielmi said he expects 1997 revenues to be around $1.15 billion. Tellabs posted earnings per share of $0.95 on revenues of $869.9 million in 1996.
